135290775183835137.title: 一篇演讲稿——我的寒假
135290775183835137.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"mcg0Lb6m"},"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"大家好！寒假，一个月，既是休整，也是学习、思考的时机。那么，我将给大家带来我的思考。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"05Va-47-"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"首先，读一本好书，可以使人受益一生。当然一生可能有些偏破，但一时还是有的。寒假，我读了马伯庸的《长安的荔枝》。书中讲述了一个叫李善德的老实人从岭南运荔枝的事。岭南，今两广一代。你要问李善德为什么要去岭南，因为杨贵妃想吃，还偏不吃蜀地的。于是千辛万苦，终于运到了，然而到最终杨贵妃都没吃。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"pD6LZhVm"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"故事的大背景发生在安史之乱前，而此时已有一些征兆，比如驿站被毁，藩王不听中央，以及著名的，给唐玄宗跳“小霓裳”的安禄山，以及杨国忠和鱼内每，也就是左明里暗里的斗争。这让我们 不过，我更想说的是文章小说对现实的讽刺。就单一例：李善德为人老实，检举自己上司及同事中饱私囊，随后被树敌，被派以几乎必死的任务。这和当代职场有什么区别？还有唐家这边几乎不可能完成的任务，批文碟几个部门踢皮球，你想这又和现实有什么区别？小说来源于现实又高于生活，大抵就是如此吧。\r","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"fwPLmpVB"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"接下来是图片。这是我寒假思考史铁生的文章后画的，很粗糙，但已经能表达我想表达的意思了。人在生活中总会遇到挫折的，而有的会给我们带来不可逆的打击。比如史铁生，20多岁，双脚明显瘫痪，本是青春的年纪啊！显然，铁生就到了这个点。事实告诉我们，史铁生在这之中感悟到了人生的真理，然后浴火重生，然而没有满血复活，因为开枪的打击不可逆，史铁生不可能回到那个双腿健全的史铁生，但没有双腿瘫痪的史铁生也不可能有他如此巨大文学成就的史铁生。所以逆境造英雄，困境可使人重生。但你看，这边有一条单薄的黑线，这就是那些走不出来的人。走不出来，困在执念中，终将走向灭亡。不可否认，低谷期，不可能像图示一样那么容易走出来，但只要挺过去，迎接你的终将是光明。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"_plGMYMf"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r然后是喜闻乐见的试题研究环节。来，诗句理解！理解理解，理解是什么？理是理性、客观，解是解释、分析。当然，数学的解和此处的意思也大差不差。说回这里，客观又指什么？我们都知道，客观题就是选择题，是不掺杂个人情感的。那么客观，就是指列不带出融人情感的原文内容。于是理解便出了：就是不带情感地对作者的文章进行分析解读。于是侧重点便出来了：抓内容。说简单点，一个口诀：拆内容抓情感，抓不住情感抓手法。你可以辜负我，但你不能辜负题目。如果还是做不到，那就好了。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"0n58MhHC"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"sFhztCre"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"说到理解，我便想到了欣赏。欣欣然睁开了眼，这是朱自清《春》里的名句。赏，你看下面有个贝，那就是与钱有关。我今天捡到一百块钱。真的哦？假的哦？于是我拿上，看一下水印和工艺，摸一下雕版印刷技术，晃一下听一下制纸工艺。哇，是真的，那我就笑纳了。类比一下，诗句欣赏也是，我们拿到一道题，先品鉴一下修辞，再赏析一下写作手法，推敲一下语言风格啊，特殊词啊，艺术手法啊等。这样一套下来，题的曲，好诗，分数我也笑纳了。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"fh97NV0H"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我看有些同学着手有点想动手一试，来，上题！谈谈你对画线部分的理解。请...同学来为我们理性解读。very good，看来…同学已经悟到了诗句理解的真意了。但是这首诗还还没结束。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"ij9zHk0r"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"倒数第二部分是我的一些思考。可以看到，这是一首格律极其工整的现代诗，四节成诗，四句成节，四字成句。但是，什么是现代诗？因为他有别于近体诗。伟大的豆包女士曾说，近体诗是戴着枷锁起舞，现代诗是把枷锁砸的粉碎。这首诗，他自由吗？不自由，他被格律捆的死死的，他每一天都没有起舞，他缚在了生命。他被格律困住，他和八股文有何区别？没有区别。于是，为了解放他，有一位神通广大的姓他去了三个之，打破了枷锁。请严老师谈一谈，您当时为什么觉得去掉掉三个之更好。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"3cnTa02e"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"好，感谢严老师，不过先别急，我这里还有两个问题想请教你，也是今天我想分享的最后一个版块。第一个我已打在PPT上了，第二个PPT上的只是一个概栝，完整的在我的语文书上。（读《选必中》P43）以上是猜题干，的问题是，写下来，的下到底是为了纪念还是忘却？请。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"27v7Bmt3"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我的分享到此也就差不多了，但思考，永远不能停滞，希望大家在学习过程中不要忘记多练，多思，多写。谢谢大家的聆听，也感谢…同学的参与和严老师的解答。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"L3pthbPt"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775183835136.title: 无题打油诗
135290775183835136.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"当太阳落下，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我打开书包，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"发现","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"作业一笔没动。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"RUgi2U_8"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"惊慌失措，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"生疏的手，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"拿着发油的笔，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"捧着答案，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"僵硬地抄着。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"zmDDQhiJ"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"语文，数学，英语，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"物理，化学，生物。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我害怕你，出题的人。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我害怕你，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"挑灯夜战的人。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一支笔，一盏灯，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一个夜晚，一个奇迹。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"7IfJneFh"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"当太阳升起，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一觉醒来，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我发现，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那是一场黄粱梦。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"Bfbu-1zb"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我打开书包，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"发现","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"作业一笔没动。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"mP25VMya"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775179640849.title: 观AI吟味诗有感而作
135290775179640849.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"为什么，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"人工智能","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"写的文章","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"没有人情味？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"gAm7gED8"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你早上背诗，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"中午背词，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"晚上背曲，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"长此以往，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你也能便试写出","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"AI 味的文章","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"T1exXqoi"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"人工智能，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实就是个","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"能对材料再加工的机器。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而人类之所以是能工智人。","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而人类之所以不只是智能，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是因为","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我们是人，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我们有生活中得到的情感。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"SGpoCUPt"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"4xa3FI83"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775179640848.title: 为什么你会觉得运气差？
135290775179640848.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"9LMMCSbm"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"i-QZXLui"},"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"哦，我的朋友，你有没有运气特别差的时候？比如偏偏今天犯困被老师抓，抽卡全是常驻，下午去问有关拍照为什么没喊你，却被告之派的事连匠人都没拍齐？如果你觉得运气差时，是不是好几件坏事连着发生？\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"stzMa_u-"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这很正常，而且和运气没关系。好比你心情好时，看到的花都是笑着的，而你心情不好的时候，路边的小草都是哭着的。有这样一个心理原理：你越不期望的事情越容易发生。当然这是谁提的并不重要，毕竟勾股定理你只用记住勾三股四弦五就好了。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"WHKYkRSt"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"于是我们开始手推理：第一件坏事发生了，你不觉得有什么，只是希望不要再有，原理生效；第二件事来了，你觉得自己运气有些不好，觉得连续发生的概率太小，原理又生效；于是第三件事又发生了。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"uw8KilXP"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"气运是若有若无的，坏事是不可避免的，我们只能尽可能减少机率，比如保持一个好心情。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"rogYBiZT"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775179640847.title: 谈现代诗与近体诗格律
135290775179640847.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"sOZXkaxv"},"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"为了防止产生歧义，首先我得先解释一下我的 “格律”：“格” 是指格式，“律” 是指韵律。把这两者说清楚了，话题也就可以开始了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"gcRYBEiq"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"近体诗，与之相对的是古体诗。这名字听着像是近现代诗的类指，实际却指唐代始期成型的律诗、绝句体系。这一体系的最大特点便是格式规范而严格，韵律规整。其中绝句一首四句，分五言绝句和七言绝句，律诗则是一首八句。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"2yKowxKg"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而现代诗便是指近现代至今的白话诗。现代诗很大的特点便是无格式要求，不强制，不压韵。按照豆包的说法便是“十分自由，想写什么写什么”。这方面最具代表的便是诗人北岛的《生活》，就一个“网”字。也有人质疑说北岛写的狗屁不通的，算哪门子诗。但据我查证，这是从北岛的《太阳城札记》节选的，而《太阳城札记》通篇都是一两句甚至几个字的诗，所以这首《生活》，当然是诗了。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"lGq6-bWC"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"说回来，现代诗流行，不仅是因为它好读好写，更因为它自由。近体诗，虽然有以白居易为代表的，路边卖菜老奶奶都能读懂的诗，但是更多的是连学者都不能一口咬定的诗，更别说复杂的韵律规则和严格的格律。而现代诗，可能是你随手写的几个思维提示词，也有可能是摘抄的几句话。如果说近体诗是戴着“枷锁”舞蹈，那现代诗便是打碎枷锁，在天地间自由起舞。\r","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"UaB11UpE"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"试问，如果白话诗也要抓格式，要求韵脚，它之于八股文又有何区别？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"tWCt-xl-"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775179640846.title: 近况小结
135290775179640846.content: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"好久不见。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"Imk7mbhH"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"当东风怀着生机而来，当笔尖擦着纸面而过，我确信，春天已然到来。朱自清在《春》中写到，“一切都像刚睡醒的样子，欣欣然张开了眼。”于是春雨连绵，让百草饮尽清甜。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"SgtQPfpY"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"在这个时节，我也已然归于校园，开始了新的征程。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"coq5mRvn"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"uqWxN1Zq"}},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"三月","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"JrVDgH4S"},"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"语文的假期作业，包含了几篇随笔。但我的作业都是最后几天赶的，小例倒也随手弄了四篇，两篇议论，两篇诗歌，然而一直存着，也忘了发，每周都说“这周再发”，可每周都会忘。哎，人的记性怎么能这么差。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"ZdZsIWVC"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"昏昏恶恶过了几周，便到了月底。月底又有什么呢？对了，又是你校一年一度的春季运动会。而运动会，又免不了直播。这次播完，可能就没有下次了。我决心要为我高中融媒体生涯划上一个完美的句号。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"9SDY5lrQ"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"于是，我便让AI写了我一直想写的直播集中调度系统。最开始贪便宜，用了Trea里面免费模型，然而前端写出来和屎一样，跟我想的大相径庭。于是后面心一狠，配崩了Open Code，花钱买了Token，用NextJS把前后端重新车了一遍。为了节约工期，重写的时候功能已经比原计划缩水了一半。而实际能用且好用的，又在这一半里缩水了一半。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"rgC_WQE9"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"鉴于去年的教训，我的分镜计划早在三月初便开始制作，培训计划更是相比去年大幅度提前。结果到最后，我的“集中调度”系统没用上，我的分镜计划也被完全打乱。说人话，努力全打水漂了，连个水花都没溅起来。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"kr3w-K1O"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"上一届的，是我的学长“见过的最卷的一届”，而我这一届，则是到现在为止最忙的一届。20多个人，能扛大扛的就四个人！我一个前后导播一体机（指我一个人能干完所有事，我觉得这一点都不夸张），还有三个菜鸡。部长更是极品尤物，事情是不干的，人是要骂的，工作是不安排的。这都还不是最让我气愤的，此人还相爱阴阳怪气，当面一套背后一套，开个会，让别人安静，结果开着开着此人自己跑下去和别人聊天去了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"CtQXJRsw"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你说，这个句号，他圆满吗，其实凭心而论，我觉得还是可以——如果只看结果。过程正如我所述一般，a total mess（一团糟），我第一天上午播完真的脑袋痛得发胀，后面五场，两天半，连带着某主任心心念念的“师生‘友谊’篮球赛”，都是放手给高一的两个导播在弄，我就挂了个“指导”的名义在旁边休息。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"8wKCk2yw"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"本次直播其实还有一个遗憾，那就是数据。直言不讳地说，这是你校有史以来直播数据最短的一届运动会，最大的原因就是没开评论。而为什么不开评论呢？这还得说回运动会。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"spoiler","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"0xmJGnyF"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"有个傻逼上课玩手机被抓，后不想上学，被威胁请家长后情绪失控想跳楼，据说坐在栏杆上荡，被几个老师直接按住，最终未果。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"spoiler","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"TSfg2PIr"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我说实话（以下内容可能引发观感不适，请谨慎阅读），这种人才是最傻逼的，有事就直接跳，跳了我还能放假，到最后又不跳，说白了就是做个样子，好到时候家长骂年轻。最烦的就是这种又当又立的，整得上面畏手畏脚的，到最后我遭殃。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"spoiler","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"2prbmBlf"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"4SIpveR7"}},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"四月","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"1Zl4wntx"},"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"到现在，四月已经过去了一半。而我收获了的，也就一个三天的清明。清明一过，便要准备月考。然而月考前，又是头大蛾子。你校荣获“无木奖”第一名的年级主任，以包括但不限于压力班主任等方式强迫我们那一屎楼回来上自习。本来你校只放一天，不放假日也罢，看我春假就算了，还想挤占属于我的休息时间。唉。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"_xGRuAnm"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"于是终于到了月考。数学、生物有所进步，英语、化学维持水平，不错。然后，我看到了单选对一个，多选对两个，实验扣三分，大题全扣完的极品的26分物理试卷。我不知道我是怎么拿着26分试卷到处晃的，我不知道我是怎么笑着告诉别人考26分的，我不知道我是怎么笑出来的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"KQpJ9vZ-"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我难道是什么很乐观的人吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"1z9lJLQq"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"x5ix3wNZ"}},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"小结","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"Fk_gTiVP"},"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“我好想哭。”","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“我没有哭出来。”","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"VPeHdFfz"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我很乖，","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我是一个好孩子","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"WidZRssT"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"很多时候，我明明知道该哭，我也想哭，但我哭不出来。就运动会那天，说实话，晚上在操场上散步，泪水在眼眶里打转，但始终流不下来。我真的很想直接躺在草地上，仰望并没有星星的星空，但是理性告诉我，地上脏，不能躺着。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"sDG1rbV3"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"很多时候，我的感性告诉我，我想买这个，想买那个，想买买买。但是我的理性告诉我，这个你已经有了，那个你买了就没有钱了，所以你不能买。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"6rhWPX2Z"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"于是写到这里，我感觉胸口有点闷，眼泪再一次打转，可理性告诉我，你不能哭，还没下课。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"bwsWD7Rp"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"于是理性压制了感性，再一次。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"7H49tSm0"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我恨理性。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"b2TgfDFe"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"ScnyjMwO"}},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"五月再见。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"$":{"blockId":"IgymCnTY"},"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

135290775179640839.title: [浅出]连自保都做不到,你拿什么谈自立自强?
135290775179640839.summary: 本文探讨当代青年的自立自强问题，指出青年自保能力普遍较弱，主要受专家言论打击和功利化教育影响。解决之道在于改革教育体制和提升青年自尊、创造力与兴趣支柱，但若连自保都难以实现，谈自立自强则毫无基础。
